name: refute_beliefs
description: Record beliefs of yours that are shown wrong. In a pause that asks, call it once; an empty list says nothing was. Otherwise call it whenever you find a belief was wrong.

note_id.description: The id of the note that is wrong.

claim.description: The belief, quoted, when no listed note holds it.

confidence.description: How firmly you held it then, not now: 1 is absolute uncertainty, 10 is complete conviction.
